description: Adds a pricing rule for one visible store. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true because pricing rules can affect many listings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

body.description: WAPI PricingRulesRequest body: SourceId, PriceFrom, PriceTo, Markup, MarkupFixed.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.

name: hgr_add_pricing_rule
title: Add Pricing Rule
